scene:
Three zones read left to right, separated by generous space.

LEFT ZONE, the funded plan: a large open navy-outlined envelope, labelled €500K + 24 ENGINEER-WEEKS above it. Out of the envelope rise three cards stacked vertically, each with one icon: a gear with a test flask on the card labelled PILOT €180K; a server rack with a circular restore arrow on the card labelled RESTORE TEST €80K; two engineer figures side by side, one teaching the other at a laptop, on the card labelled SECOND ENGINEER. Beside the envelope sits a small locked teal safe labelled RESERVE. Below the envelope, a separate grey box with a dashed outline holds three faded icons with no text: a web browser window, a globe with a pin, and two person silhouettes; this box is labelled POSTPONED.

MIDDLE ZONE, the evidence as a horizontal timeline with an arrow pointing right and five milestones, left to right: a board table labelled DAY 0: PLAN; a server with a red-ochre cross labelled DAY 45: RESTORE FAILS; an engineer figure with a check mark labelled DAY 60: ENGINEER PASSES; a server with a teal check mark labelled DAY 85: RETEST PASSES; a stopwatch whose hand has moved back, with a small down arrow, labelled DAY 90: 80 → 62 HOURS.

RIGHT ZONE, the day-100 decision: a large semicircular gauge split into three bands, left to right, labelled UNDER 60, 60–70 and OVER 70; the needle points into the middle band 60–70. Below the gauge, an arrow from the needle leads to a teal card showing a spreadsheet with a magnifying glass and a check mark, labelled DAY 100: DATA-QUALITY STEP €40K. Beneath that card, a paused road barrier in front of a globe and two person silhouettes, labelled EXPANSION AND HIRING WAIT.

The dial, screens, safe and documents carry no writing or digits. TEXT: draw exactly these labels, each once and nothing else: €500K + 24 ENGINEER-WEEKS, PILOT €180K, RESTORE TEST €80K, SECOND ENGINEER, RESERVE, POSTPONED, DAY 0: PLAN, DAY 45: RESTORE FAILS, DAY 60: ENGINEER PASSES, DAY 85: RETEST PASSES, DAY 90: 80 → 62 HOURS, UNDER 60, 60–70, OVER 70, DAY 100: DATA-QUALITY STEP €40K, EXPANSION AND HIRING WAIT. Any other text is a defect.
alt: An envelope of €500,000 and 24 engineer-weeks funds a €180,000 pilot, an €80,000 restore test and a second engineer, with a reserve beside it and the portal, a second country and hiring postponed; a timeline shows the plan at day 0, the restore failing at day 45, the second engineer passing at day 60, the retest passing at day 85 and pilot effort falling from 80 to 62 hours at day 90; a gauge lands in the 60 to 70 band, so at day 100 a €40,000 data-quality step is funded while expansion and hiring wait.
caption: Rotaline’s funded plan, the evidence the first hundred days produced, and the day-100 decision it changed.
